name: Bernd Rosemeyer
features: fair skin, blond hair, pale blue eyes, boyish square-jawed face, broad grin, athletic build, exuberant fearless expression
bio: Rosemeyer came from motorcycle racing straight into the Auto Union, and because he had never driven a front-engined car he never learned to fear the mid-engined one. European Champion in 1936 and winner of the 1936 Eifelrennen in fog so thick he could not see the road. He was killed on 28 January 1938 attempting a speed record on the Frankfurt autobahn.
